# Name: # Single-partition (no OTA) layout for 8 MB EspControl panels. Two full-size
# OTA app slots do not fit an 8 MB chip at this firmware's compiled size
# this board takes the whole app budget as one factory partition and updates
# NVS sits after the app on purpose: a USB install writes the factory image

Type: which pads every gap up to the end of the app with 0xFF. With NVS
each update would erase all saved settings.
